alphaContract: Opaque ground; binary128 city-tree alpha with zero invisible RGB
segmentation: Transparent authored atlas foreground is composited over shared grass; primary alpha components retain geometry. Opaque fallback grass selection uses G>R, G>B, R>B. Cobble road swaps only eroded inner source mask.
edgeContract: Complete4px RGBA bands for declared compatible grass/network portals; source strips retain2D texture. Whole cobble/flagstone floors are separate materials, not narrow-road plaza adapters.
limits: No game integration, pathfinding, collision, bridge gameplay, Unity import or retail parity validation.
